name: How do Zen Tiny Homes' turnkey builds compare to buying a pre-built tiny home?

mainEntity.name: How do Zen Tiny Homes' turnkey builds compare to buying a pre-built tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our turnkey builds offer a fully customized experience, allowing you to tailor every aspect of your tiny home to your unique preferences and needs, ensuring it's built to current codes and standards. While pre-built tiny homes offer quicker delivery, they often come with limited customization options and may not always meet specific local building or zoning requirements without modifications. With a turnkey build from Zen Tiny Homes, you get a personalized design, quality craftsmanship, and peace of mind knowing the entire project is managed professionally.
acceptedAnswer.description: Zen Tiny Homes' turnkey builds offer full customization and professional project management, unlike pre-built options with limited choices.
